mod.name: instruction
Pure Water, One Click: Use a container on the faucet to fill its remaining capacity.

mod.name: preserve
Pure Water, One Click: Existing contents are mixed with the new water, not removed.

mod.name: locked
Pure Water, One Click: No water supply connected. Unlock a water-supply line first.

mod.name: after.connect
Pure Water, One Click: Once connected: 100% pure water, filled to capacity.
